title: My Energy Battery Lab
interaction: Swipe or tap to change a procedural battery and character energy state.
mvp: Battery smoothly drains/fills; character state follows one canonical 0-100 scale.

title: Dash to the Charging Dock
interaction: Move an empty character to the dock; only dock contact begins charging.
mvp: Position and energy are separate; start is 0%; dock animates 0→100%.

title: Quiet Bubble Garden
interaction: Tap or swipe through floating bubbles with adjustable speed and quantity.
mvp: Stable 60fps on iPhone; object pooling; bubble count and speed controls.

title: Finger Light Trail
interaction: Draw glowing trails with finger, mouse or pen.
mvp: Smooth path interpolation, high-DPI canvas and no page scrolling while drawing.

title: Hold to Breathe
interaction: Press and hold to expand; release to settle.
mvp: Child controls every cycle and can stop instantly.

title: Calm Colour Flow
interaction: Drag colours into one another to create slow liquid-like gradients.
mvp: Procedural flow field with bounded particle count.

title: Rainmaker Window
interaction: Tap clouds to add rain; swipe to move wind.
mvp: Rain density and sound independently controllable.

title: Firefly Field
interaction: Guide slow glowing fireflies with touch.
mvp: Soft glow with luminance limits and reduced-motion freeze mode.

title: My Sound Choices
interaction: Tap clear sound tiles; control volume and stop all sounds instantly.
mvp: Every sound user-triggered; stop button works immediately.

title: Build My Calm Space
interaction: Place preferred items into a room and save a visual choice board.
mvp: Child can create, reset and locally save a calm-space picture.

title: Number Merge Playground
interaction: Combine number blocks and see totals form visually.
mvp: Supports values beyond 10 without giant DOM blocks or layout failure.

title: Count & Catch
interaction: Catch the requested number of falling objects.
mvp: 1-10 rounds with adjustable speed and no penalty for misses.

title: Number Line Hop
interaction: Tap or drag Leon along a number line.
mvp: Tap arrows work without dragging; number line remains stable.

title: Shape Snap Builder
interaction: Drag or tap shapes into a picture.
mvp: House roof is above the body; six complete pictures are visually coherent.

title: Pattern Path
interaction: Choose what comes next in a visual or movement pattern.
mvp: AB, AAB, ABB and ABC patterns with clear difficulty progression.

title: Sort & Pack
interaction: Sort objects by colour, size, shape or category.
mvp: Data-driven categories; 3-bin maximum for early levels.

title: Balance the Scale
interaction: Place objects on a seesaw scale to balance quantities.
mvp: Deterministic physics and visual equality cue.

title: Memory Garden
interaction: Match pairs on calm garden cards.
mvp: Board sizes 2x2, 3x4 and 4x4 with stable card positions.

title: Alphabet Adventure
interaction: Explore letters, hear sounds and complete short rounds.
mvp: A-Z order, clear glyphs, no robotic fallback voice when quality voice unavailable.

title: Letter Sound Hunt
interaction: Find pictures beginning with the target sound.
mvp: Human-reviewed sound mapping and Australian-English audio set.

title: Trace the Letter
interaction: Trace large upper- and lowercase letters with guided paths.
mvp: Path order cues, free retry and trace overlay that can be hidden.

title: Rhyming River
interaction: Send matching rhyme boats down the same river path.
mvp: Curated rhyme sets and clear non-rhyme distractors.

title: Word Builder
interaction: Arrange letters to build short words.
sensory: letter tiles stay fixed until moved
mvp: Curated CVC progression and read-aloud on completion.

title: Story Sequence
interaction: Put three to five picture cards in order.
mvp: Tap-tap ordering plus drag; spoken captions optional.

title: Day Train
interaction: Put Monday to Sunday carriages in order.
mvp: Full order and next/previous-day modes.

title: Month Wheel
interaction: Turn a wheel and place months in sequence.
mvp: January-December order and birthday-month mode.

title: Weather Lab
interaction: Create sun, cloud, rain and wind, then match clothing or activity choices.
mvp: Four safe weather modes with no flashing lightning.

title: Leon's Planet Pals
interaction: Explore, identify and order the eight planets.
mvp: Explorer, Find the Planet and Planet Parade modes with verified facts.

title: How Do I Feel?
interaction: Choose a feeling/body need and receive optional child-led activity choices.
mvp: Visual choice board works without sound, reading or animation.

title: My Routine Builder
interaction: Create first-then-finished routines for morning, learning, outings and bedtime.
mvp: Three-step visual routine with local save and reset.
